title: TUI redesign — accessible palette + scoped master/detail filtering
task_body: Rebuild the TUI dashboard around a master/detail layout with a scope picker (plans / agents / tasks / PRs) and a colour palette that survives mono / no-color. Each pane gets its own renderer; the theme module owns the palette.
rationale: lib.rs ties the new shape together; render.rs draws; scope.rs is the picker; theme.rs centralises colour; one pane file per kind.
